description: Local fine-tune of pucpr/biobertpt-clin for NER/de-identification and section classification on the 1500-case synthetic corpus. Metrics copied from metrics/ of the run.
command: uv run dvc exp run -S generate.n_cases=1500 -S train.base_model=pucpr/biobertpt-clin -S train.fp16=true -S train.gradient_checkpointing=true -S train.learning_rate=5e-5 -S train.epochs=3

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650, 4 GB (compute capability sm_75)

notes: The first attempt stopped when the train_sections process failed to start (Windows status 0xC0000142, before any training step). Rerunning the same command resumed at train_sections; the finished stages were not rerun.
The fine-tuned weights are not published: the base model declares no licence.
